description: Synthesize contract-conformance and real-run evidence to decide whether one bounded next P3 communication slice is justified, without implementing it.

userStories.title: Assemble an attributable communication evidence corpus
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want the relevant conformance, real-run, report, Contract, and Role evidence assembled by reference so that synthesis does not rely on memory or copied transcripts. See PRD §4.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD A matrix/verdict and PRD B three-run evidence are referenced
Required PRD A and PRD B raw evidence is directly openable in the execution workspace before synthesis
If required raw evidence is missing or unattributable, stop with OBSERVATION_INSUFFICIENT rather than relying on summaries, notes, memory, or prior chat
Relevant structured-output/retransmission traces and Sidecar reports are attributable
Current Role schema and Contract authority is included
Historical evidence is dated/labeled and not confused with current runtime evidence
Full raw Participant conversations are not copied into governance
No product source change is required
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §4. Evidence corpus assembled under .tmp/evolution/communication-evidence-synthesis-20260829/corpus.{json,md}; required PRD A/B raw evidence openable and attribution verified; no product source change; no raw conversations copied into governance.

userStories.title: Classify observed communication variance
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want each material observation classified as one-off, repeated Contract problem, provider/runtime issue, already-handled invariant, or insufficient evidence so that communication defects are not confused with thought quality. See PRD §5.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD B Slot 1 IMPROVEMENT_HYPOTHESIS parse failure is classified independently from Slice #1 Pilot conformance unless independent evidence demonstrates the same structural Contract problem
0/3 READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION is treated as a batch observation only and is not generalized into workflow route frequency or dominance
Bare-JSON/wrapper/fence variance is evaluated separately from reasoning quality
Role-schema variance is separated from provider/runtime failure
Slice #2 ENVELOPE_FAILURE recovery evidence is evaluated without broadening its authority
SCHEMA_FAILURE remains fail-closed
Provenance/reference and permission/STOP ambiguity are evaluated when evidenced
One-off Participant behavior is not promoted to shared Contract by default
No new runtime failure taxonomy is introduced merely for the synthesis
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §2–§5. Classifications in .tmp/evolution/communication-evidence-synthesis-20260829/classification.{json,md}. Slot1 IMPROVEMENT_HYPOTHESIS parse = one-off Role-schema (independent of Slice #1 Pilot); 0/3 READY = batch observation only; no runtime taxonomy migration.

userStories.title: Decide whether a bounded P3 slice is justified
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want one explicit evidence-grounded terminal decision so that P3 only expands when repeated structural communication evidence warrants it. See PRD §6.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision is exactly NO_BOUNDED_P3_SLICE_JUSTIFIED, BOUNDED_P3_SLICE_CANDIDATE, or OBSERVATION_INSUFFICIENT
A candidate requires repeated evidence across independent runs, Roles, bindings, or equivalent independent evidence
A single isolated Participant mistake is insufficient absent existing unresolved authority
Absence of READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION in the three-run batch is not used as evidence that DEFER/ESCALATE is normal, dominant, or statistically more likely
Any candidate states observed problem, evidence refs, minimum affected Roles, smallest Contract change, non-goals, stop behavior, and falsification condition
A candidate explains why a local Role fix is insufficient
No next P3 implementation is performed in this Story
No full P3 platform is proposed
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §3 and §6. A candidate is a proposal, not implementation authority. Human-approved for execution; all evidence provenance and STOP conditions remain binding.

userStories.title: Close the program evidence status
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want current repository authority to reflect only evidence that actually changed so that future work can resume without replaying the whole investigation. See PRD §7.
acceptanceCriteria: Current-product-stage is updated only for statuses actually changed by PRD A/B/C evidence
Run-by-run transcripts remain in evidence artifacts rather than current-product-stage
Product decisions are added only for genuine product decisions rather than numbering
Full P3 remains DEFERRED unless Human separately authorizes it
No candidate P3 implementation PRD is silently executed
The program terminal decision is easy to locate from current authority
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §7–§9. Stop at the Human Gate. Human-approved for execution; all evidence provenance and STOP conditions remain binding.
